question: When knots sit on the vertices of a cubic graph and share its edges as distinctions, how many distinctions must linear local reasoning hold at once to see that the network's total charge makes it impossible, over which coefficient rings, and does the program's plain hole criterion or the graph's treewidth predict that number?

definitions.charge network: a connected cubic graph; a distinction on every edge; at every vertex a knot on its three edges. Z2-Tseitin: Boolean edges, the vertex knot asks the edge values to sum to the vertex's charge mod 2. Z3-Tseitin: edges oriented from lower to higher vertex number, values mod 3, the vertex knot asks outgoing minus incoming values to equal the charge mod 3. NAE: Boolean edges, the vertex knot asks its three edges not to be all equal
definitions.impossible: a Z_p charge network whose charges sum to a nonzero value mod p
definitions.level-k affine relaxation over R: variables z[S,f] for every set S of at most k edges and every assignment f of S satisfying the vertex knots whose three edges lie in S; equations z[{}] = 1 and z[S,f] = sum of z[S+e,f'] over extensions f' of f; the least refuting level L(R) is the least k at which no solution in R exists
definitions.hole at S: the reduced homology H~_{|S|-2}(Delta_S; R) of the complex Delta_S of partial assignments to subsets of S that satisfy every knot inside them; the plain hole bound is the largest B such that no set of at most B edges has a hole
definitions.toggle width tgw(G): the least k such that some sequence of vertex sets from the empty set to all of V, each obtained from the previous by adding or removing one vertex v, has every step's edge set delta(U) union star(v) of size at most k, where delta(U) is the set of edges leaving U
definitions.giant-separator number g(G): the least number of edges whose removal leaves no component with more than half the vertices

public_inputs.graphs: every connected cubic graph on 4, 6 and 8 vertices: K4, K33, the triangular prism, and the five on 8 vertices, generated by the producer, checked pairwise non-isomorphic and recorded
public_inputs.z2_placements: charge 1 at vertex 0; charges 1 at vertices 0, 1, 2; one random odd placement per graph (seed 20261020); control: charges 1 at vertices 0 and 1 (even total, possible)
public_inputs.z3_placements: on K4, K33 and the prism: charge 1 at vertex 0; charges 1, 1, 2 at vertices 0, 1, 2
public_inputs.rings: Z2-Tseitin: F2 and Z at level 3; F3 and F5 from level 3 upward; Q from level 3 upward for every placement on graphs with at most 9 edges and for the first placement on 8-vertex graphs. Z3-Tseitin: F3 and Z at level 3; F2 and F5 upward; Q upward on K4 and the prism
public_inputs.budget: levels rise until the relaxation refutes, up to level 8, 400,000 variables for F_p, and 160,000 variables for Q; an instance not refuted within budget is reported as unresolved above its last level
public_inputs.knot_shapes: the 34 knots on three Boolean variables (knotlab two_loop_knots), and the sum-mod-3 knot

forbidden_inputs: the toggle width, separator numbers or predicted levels as inputs to the linear-algebra computations

predictions.P1: rings that compute in the charge group refute at level 3: F2 and Z for Z2-Tseitin, F3 and Z for Z3-Tseitin
predictions.P2: over every other tested ring (F3, F5, Q for Z2-Tseitin; F2, F5, Q for Z3-Tseitin) the least refuting level equals the toggle width tgw(G), on every graph and placement resolved within budget
predictions.P3: the plain hole bound is 2 on every Tseitin and NAE network over F2, F3 and Q; on the 34 Boolean knots, the hole at the scope has rank |E| - 1, where E is the excluded set, so only atoms have none
predictions.P4: the least refuting level over Q (and over F3) is not a function of treewidth: two roster graphs with equal treewidth have different levels
predictions.P5: the least refuting level does not depend on the charge placement
predictions.P6: every NAE network on the roster is possible

primary_observable: per graph, network, placement and ring: the least refuting level with a solution certificate one level below and a refutation certificate at it; per graph: treewidth, treewidth of the line graph, cutwidth, toggle width (and its monotone version), g(G); hole ranks at every scope
cheapest_meaningful_control: (1) The even-charge control networks must never be refuted, up to the level that holds every edge on graphs with at most 9 edges. (2) Every verdict carries a certificate the checker verifies by substitution. (3) The homology code must give the known values: no hole for the atom and for the full relation, rank 3 for parity. (4) P2 is falsifiable: tgw(G) - 1 or tgw(G) + 1 in its place must fail somewhere.
independent_check: check_result.py rebuilds every system with separate code and verifies every stored certificate by substitution, recomputes graph parameters by separate algorithms, recomputes hole ranks by a second method, and recounts NAE possibility by brute force
decision_or_followup_rule: A signal is P1-P6 holding on every resolved case. If the refuting level over Q is a function of treewidth on the roster (P4 fails), the epic's stop rule applies. If P2 fails, ticket B's conjecture is revised or refuted before any proof is attempted.
first_executable_signal: graph generation and parameters, holes, then levels on K4, K33 and the prism, then 8-vertex graphs
stop_rule: Stop after the declared roster or the budget; stop early only on a solver, generator or control failure.
notes: The hand argument behind P3 was made before this freeze: a knot excluding two or more states leaves the pairwise-consistent point masses of an excluded state unfillable, so every such knot is a hole at its scope.

The derivation behind P2 (an averaging argument over cycle-space symmetries reducing the relaxation to sign relations among cuts) was made before this freeze and is the subject of ticket B; it has not been checked.
nonclaims: Finite enumeration on the declared graphs, placements, rings and levels only; general statements belong to ticket B.
Charge networks with knots of arity three on cubic graphs only; no OR-combinations, no Nullstellensatz degree.
No claim about native structure, distance or physics.
